heroHeadline: Zelensky Warns Russia Planning 'Massive' Attack and Northern Offensive; Ukraine Hits Taganrog, Armavir, Volgograd in Energy Campaign — Day 1,557
heroSubtitle: On Day 1,557 of Russia's full-scale invasion, Zelensky warned intelligence indicates Russia is preparing a 'massive' new attack and possible northern Ukraine offensive — meeting intelligence chief Budanov and NSDC Secretary Umerov while sending an urgent letter to Trump on critical Patriot missile shortages. Russia's 232-drone + 1 ballistic overnight barrage struck 14 regions (217 intercepted). Ukraine countered with a sweeping overnight energy campaign: Taganrog port tanker and fuel storage ablaze, Armavir oil depot set afire (~500 km from Ukraine), Volgograd refinery forced to halt — pushing Russia's 2026 energy losses to $9.5B+. A Russian Geran drone strayed into NATO territory and crashed into a Romanian apartment in Galati (2 injured), prompting an emergency Romanian defense council session. Ukraine's 40th Marine Brigade deployed Barracuda naval drones to destroy Russian positions in the Kherson region, expanding riverine drone warfare. Cumulative Russian losses reached ~1,364,060 (+1,560 on May 31 per Ukrainian General Staff); 253 combat engagements recorded with 52 enemy assaults repelled in the Pokrovsk sector alone.
